name: Takkle
description: Takkle 项目、卡片和日历；服务端连接 Supabase，AI 可读取或在授权后修改。
descriptionEn: Takkle projects, cards and calendar, with account-scoped server-side Supabase access and optional agent writes.

settings.label: Takkle account email
settings.hint: Only calendars this account belongs to are accessible. Shared by users of this UI instance.

settings.label: Supabase server secret
settings.hint: Encrypted server-side storage. Alternatively set TAKKLE_SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY in the server environment. Never use this key in browser code.

settings.label: Allowed calendar IDs
settings.hint: Optional comma-separated IDs to narrow the account's calendars further. Empty uses the account's current memberships.

settings.label: Allow Takkle changes
settings.hint: Enables card/project/column changes for calendars where the account is an owner or editor. Agent writes also respect conversation read-only and review modes.
